==English== ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*kh₂eyd-}} From {{inh|en|enm|deciden}}, from {{der|en|fro|decider}}, from {{der|en|la|dēcīdere}}, infinitive of {{m|la|dēcīdō|t=cut off, decide}}, from {{m|la|dē|t=down from}} + {{m|la|caedō|t=cut}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/dɪˈsaɪd/}} * {{audio|en|en-us-decide.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|aɪd|s=2}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To [[resolve]] (a [[contest]], [[problem]], [[dispute]], etc.); to [[choose]], [[determine]], or [[settle]]. #: {{syn|en|choose|determine|pick|elect|Thesaurus:choose}} #: {{ux|en|The election will be '''decided''' on foreign policies.}} #: {{ux|en|It was '''decided''' to meet here at midnight.}} #: {{ux|en|Her last-minute goal '''decided''' the game.}} #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Henry 6-1|IV|i|passage=The quarrel toucheth none but us alone; / Betwixt ourselves let us '''decide''' it then.}} #* {{quote-book |en |date=December 21, 1987 |author=w:Richard Nixon |title=Letters to Trump |publisher=Winning Team Publishing |year_published=2023 |ISBN=9781735503752 |OCLC=1375593143 |page=10 |text=I did not see the program, but Mrs. Nixon told me that you were great on the Donahue Show.
As you can imagine, she is an expert on politics and she predicts that whenever you '''decide''' to run for office you will be a winner!}} # {{lb|en|intransitive}} To make a [[judgment]], especially after [[deliberation]]. #: {{syn|en|judge|make up one's mind|Thesaurus:decide}} #: {{ux|en|You must '''decide''' between good and evil.}} #: {{ux|en|I have '''decided''' that it is healthier to walk to work.}} #* {{RQ:KJV|1 Kings|20|40|passage=So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast '''decided''' it.}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To cause someone to come to a [[decision]]. #: {{ux|en|Your admonition '''decide'''d me against my intended [[course of action]].}} # {{lb|en|computability theory}} Of a [[Turing machine#Noun|Turing machine]]: to return a correct answer (for some yes-or-no problem) on every possible [[input#Noun|input]]. #: {{ux|en|No Turing Machine can '''decide''' the [[halting problem#Noun|halting problem]].}} # {{lb|en|obsolete}} To [[cut off]]; to [[separate]]. #: {{syn|en|divorce|sever|sunder|Thesaurus:divide}} #* {{RQ:Fuller Holy State|passage=Our seat denies us traffic here; / The sea, too near, '''decides''' us from the rest.}} ====Usage notes==== * This is a [[catenative]] verb that takes the ''to infinitive''. See [[Appendix:English catenative verbs]] ====Conjugation==== {{en-conj|stem=decid|old=1}} ====Derived terms====
